Type.evidence_source: All the interviews were transcribed almost verbatim by the author. In general, the analysis follows the systematic text condensation method (Malterud, 2001; 2002), a method based on elements from both phenomenological analysis and grounded theory (Smith, 2003) and modified by Malterud. Malterud states that the method is suitable for descriptive transverse analysis of material from many different informants for developing new descriptions and concepts. The analysis has four stages: first, all the interviews are read through several times to acquire an overall picture and to capture the essence of what is recounted in each suicide case. The first author had already gained a good insight into the material during the process of interviewing and transcribing.
